extraFacts.fact: Wave 4 products are API certified and supplied with the API monogram by API-licensed manufacturers to the applicable specification: API 6A, API 16A, API 16C, API 16D or API 7K.

faqs.q: What is a Cameron U style 13-5/8" 10K blind-shear ram block assembly used for?
faqs.a: A blind-shear ram block cuts through drill pipe with hardened H13 tool-steel shear blade inserts and seals the open bore with an HNBR blind-face seal in a single closure. It is the last-resort BOP function on a 13-5/8" 10K stack and is mandatory on every land BOP stack per API STD 53.

faqs.q: What pipe can the 13-5/8" 10K blind-shear ram block shear?
faqs.a: It shears up to 5-1/2" drill pipe, in API grades S135, G105 and E75. Check your string against that range before you rely on the ram, and send the pipe OD, wall and grade through [our contact page](/contact) so the blade set is matched to the programme.

faqs.q: What is the working pressure of the 13-5/8" 10K blind-shear ram block?
faqs.a: The ram block is rated 10,000 psi cold working pressure, 10K class, for 13-5/8" bore BOPs. The temperature rating is -20°F to 250°F (-29°C to 121°C), the sour-service envelope. It fits the 13-5/8" 10K stack, so match the cavity size and pressure class to your preventer.

faqs.q: What are the blade inserts and seals of the 13-5/8" 10K blind-shear ram made from?
faqs.a: The block is forged AISI 4130 alloy steel with hardened H13 tool-steel shear blade inserts, and the top seal and blind-face seal are HNBR in the sour-service grade. The part is listed to NACE MR0175 / ISO 15156 sour service. Replace the blade inserts after any shear event.

faqs.q: Which OEM ram blocks does the 13-5/8" 10K blind-shear ram assembly replace?
faqs.a: It is listed as a fit for the Cameron U / UII 13-5/8" 10K (Type-U ISR compatible), with cross-references to the Shaffer NXT-S and NOV Pressure Control blind-shear rams at 13-5/8" 10K. Indus Hydraulics is not an authorised distributor of these OEMs; parts are made to the OEM dimensional standard.

faqs.q: What is in the kit with the 13-5/8" 10K blind-shear ram block?
faqs.a: The kit is one blind-shear ram block, top and bottom shear blade inserts, one top seal, one blind-face seal, four ram screws and a tube of assembly grease, for a single cavity. See [BOP spare parts and elastomers](/c/bop-spare-parts) for redress kits and matching soft goods.

faqs.q: When should the 13-5/8" 10K blind-shear ram blades be replaced?
faqs.a: Replace the blade inserts after any shear event. The soft goods are normally replaced annually on the 12-month elastomer redress used on Aramco-style programmes, and the block body can last several redress cycles if it passes dimensional inspection.

faqs.q: How does the blind-shear ram block differ from a pipe ram block of the same size?
faqs.a: A blind-shear block shears the pipe and seals the empty bore, while the [13-5/8" 10K pipe ram block for 5" drill pipe](/p/pipe-ram-block-assembly-cameron-u-style-13-5-8-10k-for-5-drill-pipe-sour-service-nace-mr0175) seals only around a pipe of that OD. A 13-5/8" 10K stack normally carries both, and both fit the same Cameron U cavity size.

faqs.q: Where is the Cameron U style 13-5/8" 10K blind-shear ram block assembly used?
faqs.a: It is the blind-shear ram replacement after a shear event on land stacks, on mainstream 13-5/8" 10K development drilling, on Aramco, ADNOC and KOC programmes, and for subsea stack blind-shear rams. Blind-shear is mandatory as the last-resort function per API STD 53.

faqs.q: What documents come with the Cameron U style 13-5/8" 10K blind-shear ram block assembly?
faqs.a: The Cameron U style 13-5/8" 10K blind-shear ram block assembly ships with a dimensional inspection report against the OEM datum, an EN 10204 3.1 mill test report (3.2 on request), heat-number and batch traceability, and API 16A documentation. It is supplied as an API-certified, API-monogrammed part from an API-licensed manufacturer; the NACE MR0175 / ISO 15156 sour-service compliance certificate is included.

faqs.q: What is a Cameron U style 11" 10K pipe ram block assembly for 5" drill pipe used for?
faqs.a: This pipe ram block seals around 5" drill pipe (5.000" OD) in an 11" 10K BOP cavity, holding well pressure with the pipe in the hole. It is the slim-hole and workover ram block for sour-service infill drilling, and 5" drill pipe is the most common workover string OD.

faqs.q: What pipe size does the 11" 10K pipe ram block fit?
faqs.a: This block is sized for 5" drill pipe, 5.000" OD, and it will not seal other pipe sizes. For a cavity that must seal a range of ODs, use the [11" 10K variable bore ram for 3-1/2" to 5" pipe](/p/variable-bore-ram-vbr-block-assembly-cameron-u-style-11-10k-3-1-2-5-range-sour-service-nace-mr0175) instead.

faqs.q: What is the working pressure of the 11" 10K pipe ram block assembly?
faqs.a: The pipe ram block is rated 10,000 psi cold working pressure, 10K class, for 11" bore BOPs. The temperature rating is -20°F to 250°F (-29°C to 121°C), the sour-service envelope. Match the cavity bore and pressure class to your preventer before ordering.

faqs.q: What material is the 11" 10K pipe ram block made from?
faqs.a: The block is forged AISI 4130 alloy steel with NACE MR0175 hardness control, and the top seal, front packer and side packers are HNBR in the sour-service grade. The listing is sour service to NACE MR0175 / ISO 15156, so it suits wells with H2S exposure.

faqs.q: Which OEM pipe rams does the 11" 10K pipe ram block replace?
faqs.a: It is listed to fit the Cameron U 11" 10K, with cross-references to the Shaffer SL and Hydril V 11" 10K pipe rams. Indus Hydraulics is not an authorised distributor of these OEMs; parts are made to the OEM dimensional standard, so quote your OEM part number or BOP serial number.

faqs.q: How often is the 11" 10K pipe ram block replaced?
faqs.a: Only the soft goods are routinely replaced: usually annually on the 12-month elastomer redress, or earlier when the packer or front seal degrades. The block body can last multiple redress cycles if surface condition passes dimensional inspection.

faqs.q: How does the 11" 10K pipe ram block differ from the 13-5/8" version?
faqs.a: The 11" block fits an 11" 10K cavity, while the [13-5/8" 10K pipe ram block for 5" drill pipe](/p/pipe-ram-block-assembly-cameron-u-style-13-5-8-10k-for-5-drill-pipe-sour-service-nace-mr0175) fits the larger mainstream stack. faqs.q: What is a Cameron U style 11" 10K variable bore ram (VBR) block for 3-1/2" to 5" pipe used for?
faqs.a: A variable bore ram seals on a range of pipe ODs, here 3-1/2" to 5", in an 11" 10K cavity. It is used on multi-tubular drilling and workover programmes where one cavity must seal different string sizes, and it wears faster than a fixed-OD pipe ram.

faqs.q: What pipe range does the 11" 10K VBR block seal on?
faqs.a: It seals on pipe or tubing from 3-1/2" to 5" OD in an 11" bore preventer. Below or above that range you need a different ram. For 5" drill pipe only, a fixed [11" 10K pipe ram block](/p/pipe-ram-block-assembly-cameron-u-style-11-10k-for-5-drill-pipe-sour-service-nace-mr0175) is the simpler choice.

faqs.q: What is the 11" 10K VBR block made from?
faqs.a: The block is forged AISI 4130 alloy steel with NACE MR0175 hardness control. It has an HNBR top seal, a multi-segment front packer with steel inserts and HNBR side packers, in the sour-service grade, and the listing is sour service to NACE MR0175 / ISO 15156.
